title: Foreign guests
subtitle: Passport, visa and Form C for guests who are not Indian nationals. Tick "Foreign national" on a booking to add the guest here.

how.title: How Form C works
how.step1: At check-in, collect a copy of the passport photo page and the visa page.
how.step2: Fill the record here so you have the details in one place.
how.step3: Submit Form C on the FRRO portal within 24 hours of the guest's arrival. You need an accommodation login on the portal; this app does not submit it for you.
how.step4: Enter the Form C reference number and tick "Form C submitted".
